overview: Hephaestus is a Legendary Support from the Hearts faction. Think of him as a stationary fortress - he plants himself in one spot and creates a network of three mechanical devices across the field.

At the start of battle, all three devices are inactive. Every time Hephaestus casts his Ultimate, one device turns on. Once a device is active, it becomes a safe zone for your allies - they heal up and gain energy inside it, while enemies trapped there become weaker (lower attack and attack speed).

The real power comes when all three devices are active at once. When that happens, they create a massive effect across the entire battlefield - your enemies take more damage from your team, and your allies attack faster and hit harder for 5 seconds. This resets each time Hephaestus uses his Ultimate.
Core: Activate all 3 devices through Ultimates. Payoff: Field-wide buff when all devices are online. Trade: Must stay planted at his forge to work and not so good in the early game.

coreMechanic.label: vs Other Hearts Supports
bullets: vs Caishen (Energy Battery): Caishen's job is to give your team constant energy so their damage dealers can cast their big moves over and over. He is not a pure Caishen replacement, but he provides conditional zone-based Energy plus damage amplification. His devices weaken enemies while protecting allies, and he needs energy himself to activate all three devices in a fight.

vs Yuelao (Pair Linker): Yuelao links two specific allies together - usually your strongest attacker and your tankiest hero - and they share stats with each other. Hephaestus doesn't link anyone. Instead, his zones help anyone standing in them equally. He also stops one enemy at a time with restraint, controlling which threat matters most.

vs Mengpo (Revive Support): Mengpo brings dead allies back to life if she stacks up her Samsara power. Hephaestus prevents allies from dying in the first place - his zones heal them constantly and reduce damage they take. It's prevention over rescue.

Hephaestus' unique advantage: He's the only Hearts support with a physical/tanky nature. All the others are magical supports. This means he scales differently with gear and can survive in spots where other supports get deleted. But he must stay put - if he gets moved away from his forge, he gets stunned for 5 seconds.

skills.name: Mech Domain
skills.description: Summons 3 inactive mechanical devices at combat start. When cast, activates the furthest device. Allies within its AoE restore 15 Energy and HP equal to 50% ATK per sec. Enemies in the AoE gain -15% ATK and -20% ATK SPD. If all devices are activated, decreases enemy DMG by 20%, grants all allies 30% DMG bonus and 50% ATK SPD for 5s.

upgrades.text: Allies restore 20 Energy and HP equal to 60% ATK per sec.
Enemies gain -20% ATK and -30% ATK SPD.
All devices active: decreases enemy DMG by 40%, grants 50% DMG bonus and 80% ATK SPD.

skills.note: Getting all 3 devices active takes time (3 Ultimates), so fights need to last long enough for Hephaestus to reach that full-field payoff. The Fusion effect (all 3 active) is transformational for team damage and survival.

skills.name: Undying Forge
skills.description: At combat start, Hephaestus places a forge before him. In the [Dedicated] state near the bench, he gains infinite attack range and 30% DMG RED. If he moves away, the forge teleports him back and inflicts Overload, disabling him for 5s.

upgrades.text: In [Dedicated] state, CD of Artisan's Insight and Molten Aegis -50%.
In [Dedicated] state, Hephaestus takes 60% less DMG.

skills.note: Relic Lv1 establishes Hephaestus's core identity: immobile but nigh-untouchable. Lv2 (Relic Lv.10) is a major spike - halving cooldowns on his heal and restraint lets him cycle abilities twice as fast. Lv4 stacks to 90% total DR with base 30%, making him nearly invincible if positioned safely.

skills.name: Artisan's Insight
skills.description: Fires a beam to restrain the enemy with the highest DPS for 2 seconds (+0.5s for each activated device), reducing their Armor and M-RES by 20%. Vulnerable targets take more damage, making this a key setup tool.

upgrades.text: Duration extends by 1s for each activated device on the field.

skills.note: Scales with devices: Lv3 changes per-device scaling from +0.5s to +1s duration. By Lv3, the restraint can reach 5 seconds with all 3 devices active. Critical for locking down high-threat enemies.

skills.name: Primal Resonance
skills.description: Hephaestus's Energy Regen +20%. This is always active and critical - Hephaestus must cast his Ultimate 3 times in a single fight to get all devices online.
skills.note: Lv4 is a massive power spike: 200 starting Energy means Hephaestus enters fights ready to immediately activate the first device. Energy regen stats (Far 2/3 Virtues, energy-regen gear) become essential for hitting 3 Ultimates per fight.

skills.name: Molten Aegis
skills.description: Heals the weakest ally for HP equal to 150% ATK and reduces their incoming DMG by 10% for 5s. For each activated device on the field, further reduces incoming DMG by 5%.

upgrades.text: For each device, further reduces DMG by 7.5%.
Healing increased to HP equal to 200% ATK.

skills.note: Targets the weakest ally automatically. Damage reduction scales with devices: at Lv3 with all 3 devices active, healed allies take 32.5% less damage. Combined with the device zones, this creates multiple survival layers.

skillUpgradePriority: 1. Primal Resonance (Energy Passive) - Lv4's 200 starting Energy enables immediate first device activation; Energy regen is the critical stat
2. Mech Domain (Ultimate) - More device activations per fight directly scales all of his other outputs
3. Undying Forge (Relic) - Lv2 halved cooldowns doubles active skill cycling speed; Lv4 near-invincibility in protected position
4. Artisan's Insight - Restraint duration scales with device count at Lv3; key for locking the highest threat
5. Molten Aegis - Healing and damage reduction scale with devices; lower priority than core energy and device systems

paragraphs: Hephaestus must stay at his forge position. His Relic grants infinite attack range and 30% damage reduction while he remains in the Dedicated state. Forced movement away from the forge triggers Overload - a 5-second stun that leaves the team without support. Place him in the back corner before the fight starts and do not expect repositioning.

strengths: Exceptional team sustain - Multi-layer healing (150-200% ATK scaling) plus damage reduction stacking makes team nearly unkillable once ramped
Teamwide damage amplification - +30% all-ally damage bonus when all 3 devices active; synergizes perfectly with DPS-heavy carries
Heavy enemy debuff layers - Reduces enemy ATK by 15%, ATK SPD by 20%, and armor/M-RES by up to 50% while restraining highest threat
Scales infinitely with energy regen - Each point of energy regen accelerates device activation; exponential power growth with Fervor/Far virtue sets
Unique support role - Only physical/tanky support in game, scales differently with gear and doesn't overlap with magical supports
weaknesses: Requires time to reach peak power - Needs 3 Ultimates (~15-20 seconds) to activate all 3 devices; crippled in short fights or early-game rushes
Immobility creates positioning risk - Forge anchors him to one location; forced movement away triggers 5-second stun that leaves team without support
Catastrophic to displacement CC - Pan/Khepri/Set pulls mean stun + defenseless team; one bad position equals match loss
Energy starvation is fatal - Pan's energy drain and Cronus cooldown reduction prevent him from hitting 3 Ultimates; hard-countered by energy-denial supports
Vulnerable to burst compositions - Fast teams can burst down team before 3 devices activate or before he heals allies to safety
Assassins with CC like Nyx can mute his healing and stun him before he gets going
Displacement/Pull heroes that move Hephaestus away from his forge trigger a 5-second stun that completely disables him

paragraphs: Energy Supports (Caishen): Hephaestus needs to cast his Ultimate 3 times during a fight. Caishen gives massive amounts of energy to the whole team, getting Hephaestus to his third Ultimate faster.

Zone Control Heroes (Geb, Prometheus): These heroes create their own areas of effect that trap or control enemies. Combined with Hephaestus's zones, enemies have nowhere to run and stay debuffed longer.
AoE Control (Pan, Poseidon): They hit multiple enemies at once or control wide areas. Hephaestus's debuffs make these attacks even stronger.
Magic Damage Heroes (Isis, Hecate): These heroes deal magic damage and scale off his attack stat. Plus, they benefit from the 30% damage boost when all devices are active.

playstyle: Hephaestus works in phases. The opening 15-20 seconds are his weakest window - he has devices to activate and needs energy to do it. Protect him during this phase and let Caishen or another energy source push him toward his third Ultimate.

Once all three devices are active, the team dynamics shift completely. Enemies debuffed, allies healed and boosted, the restraint on the highest-threat target extended to its maximum duration. At that point Hephaestus isn't just a support - he is the field itself, dictating what happens everywhere at once.

Position him carefully before the fight starts and do not expect repositioning. One displacement ability against Hephaestus - a single pull from Pan, a dive from Khepri - costs the team five seconds of support. Avoid that outcome by anticipating aggressive flanks before deploying him.
